model.name: U-Net, MobileNet v1 0.25 encoder, round 4 (retrained on rounds 1-3 answers + OSM building footprints as rooftop negatives)

detectionRule: city-wide mosaic; probability >= 0.6; opening 2 px, closing 3 px; area >= 2000 m2; mean probability >= 0.78; < 30% on OSM building footprints (OpenFreeMap); < 30% overlap with OSM lots/structures/confirmed lots; excludes areas reviewed in rounds 1-3; oriented right-angled outlines; every outline render-checked
